mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < 0% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tighter monetary policy, which can lead to lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of increasing PAYEMS and decreasing UNRATE does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a weakening in the housing market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -5% does not lead to a statistically significant negative return in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
